title: Physical Symptoms (PHQ-15)
about: Fifteen physical symptoms in the past 4 weeks, each answered from 0 (not bothered at all) to 2 (bothered a lot), scored 0 to 30. Scores of 5, 10 and 15 mark low, medium and high somatic symptom severity (Kroenke 2002). Question 4 (d on Pfizer's form) is for women only.

source.name: PHQ-15 (Kroenke, Spitzer and Williams), from phqscreeners.com

blocks.label: During the past 4 weeks, how much have you been bothered by any of the following problems?
items: Pain in your arms, legs, or joints (knees, hips, etc.)
Menstrual cramps or other problems with your periods (women only)
Feeling your heart pound or race
Pain or problems during sexual intercourse
Feeling tired or having low energy

blocks.text: Published cut-offs (Kroenke 2002): 5 or more, low somatic symptom severity; 10 or more, medium somatic symptom severity; 15 or more, high somatic symptom severity.
